findings.reason: Moving the source scans out (rev-0003/0005/0012) left the `[ac:ac-zrodla-zdarzen-korzeni-entities-i-rel]` test title promising '… and no entity-projection module mounts one', but its body now asserts only the hook half: nothing is mounted before `mountRegistryRoots`, and then `entities`/`releases` are mounted at their fixed dirs. The 'no M29 store/indexer mounts or watches a source' half lives only in tests/integration/architecture/registry-mounts-source.test.ts, which has no `[ac:]` tag, so slug-based coverage tooling no longer links that clause to the criterion. Add `[ac:ac-zrodla-zdarzen-korzeni-entities-i-rel]` to the first architecture test (the projection-module scan), or drop the clause from this test's title so the title says only what the test asserts.
